Apex Dental Partners | Full-Stack Developer | Dallas, TX | REMOTE (US) or HYBRID | Full-time | apexdp.com

We're a Dental Support Organization running 65 practices across eight states. Dentistry doesn't sound like a technical job, but the platform behind it is: we've built our own operations system (Rails 8 + React, Electron, Go, and C#/.NET against OpenDental, all on AWS) and we're pushing hard on automation and AI to make the practices run better.

The team is small and developers own problems end-to-end. You'll figure out why a billing workflow breaks down, design the fix, ship it, and hear from the office manager who uses it the next week. Recent work includes an AI-first metrics layer that answers operational questions in chat, automated patient scheduling and communication, insurance verification scraping, and a live PMS integration across every practice. The domain is wide (clinical workflows, payroll, patient comms, revenue cycle) and there's a lot of novel work left once you learn the business. Big emphasis placed on being able to sit down with non-engineering team members and understand their workflows and build software to make it better.

Good fit if you want a stable company, a small team, broad latitude, and work that visibly matters to the people using it. We're actively building new features, not just maintaining what exists, so there's a healthy mix of greenfield work and improving a platform that's already in daily use by our nearly 1,000 employees.

Must reside in the US and be authorized to work in the US without sponsorship.

Email me directly: dhanson [at] apexdp.com

Search Atlas | Product Engineer (Product Manager role, not a Full-stack role) | REMOTE (anywhere, EST hours) | Full-time contractor | $23-$34 USD/hour | https://careers.searchatlas.com/jobs/599248-product-engineer...

We're ~160 people, fully remote, building an AI marketing platform. Our main product is OTTO, which runs a site's SEO on its own - it reads live search data and pushes the technical and on-page fixes itself, nobody queues them up. Around that we've got ad automation for Google and Meta, GBP management for multi-location brands, content gen, and LLM visibility tracking (whether ChatGPT and co are citing you). Autotrader, Hyundai, P&G, Vendasta are some of our customers.

Work happens in pods, 1 PM and 2-4 engineers. You own your pod's roadmap and ship it with them, no veteran PM signing off on your specs first. That's the part most PM roles won't hand you.

Looking for 3+ years PM in B2B SaaS with an actual technical background - eng or QA before PM, or a PM who's been getting into the codebase themselves. You should be able to read Python and TS, write your own SQL, find your way around an API, and not need an engineer to tell you what a stack trace says. We're Django on the back, React/Next on the front. QA is yours end to end including release sign-off, people tend to underestimate that bit. And you're already using Claude Code or similar daily, not "open to it".

Process is screen with me, a take-home that runs about 75 mins, technical round with one of our senior PMs, then a call with our Director of Product (who you'd report to). I usually come back to people within 2 business days.

Our ATS forces us to list specific countries but we hire from anywhere as long as you can do EST hours, so apply even if yours isn't on there.

Apply at the link and mention HN somewhere, in your pitch or wherever it fits. I'm João Pedro, I read all of your emails. joao.pedro@searchatlas.com if you need me, though the link's faster.

P.S: If you're not a PM, you can still reach out, explain your role briefly and I can redirect you to an appropriate role, or you could just check out our careers page and apply directly to the role that suits you best (preferred method).

Spanish National Cancer Research Centre (CNIO) | Madrid, Spain | HYBRID | Senior Scientific Computing Engineer | Full-time

CNIO is one of Europe's leading cancer research centres. We're looking for a senior scientific computing engineer to join the IT, Scientific Computing and AI area and take ownership of the infrastructure behind our research, from genomics pipelines to AI models. You'll be the senior scientific computing person in the area, reporting directly to me (the area head), and you'll help define where scientific computing at CNIO goes over the next few years.

What you'll do:

- Shape the roadmap for scientific computing at the centre and drive it forward

- Own and evolve our HPC cluster (Slurm): scheduling, monitoring, capacity planning, user support

- Build out our GPU / AI infrastructure as the centre's ML workloads grow

- Work with researchers to turn their analyses into robust, reproducible pipelines and tools

- Optional: co-author research papers

What we're looking for:

- Several years running Linux HPC environments in production (Slurm or similar)

- Comfortable with automation (Ansible, Python), containers (Apptainer/Docker) and workflow managers (Nextflow, Snakemake or similar)

- Someone who wants to set direction, not just keep the lights on

- Bonus: Ceph, Kubernetes, GPU stacks, a bioinformatics background

- Spanish not required

If interested: tdidomenico-at-cnio-dot-es.

Mattermost | Remote (US and Canada) | FT | Multiple roles

Mattermost (https://mattermost.com) is an open-core collaboration and workflow automation platform for air-gapped, on-prem and private clouds. Our customers are in defense, intelligence, security and critical infrastructure, including the USAF and NASA. Y Combinator led our Series B, their largest open source investment at the time.

Both openings are full stack on the core platform: Go backend, React/TypeScript frontend, PostgreSQL and Redis. The codebase is public (https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost), so most of what you build is too. We would rather hire people who ship and own complex software end to end than chase an exact stack match, so any systems or backend language and any frontend stack counts. What we look for in both roles: REST and WebSocket APIs with real networking fundamentals (HTTP, connection lifecycle), and relational databases including schema design and query optimization.

We use coding agents daily (Claude Code, Cursor, and others) for scaffolding, refactors, code review and test generation, and we treat that as core craft rather than a shortcut around the fundamentals. If you have a track record of shipping and owning complex software end-to-end, we want to hear from you.

*Senior Full Stack Engineer* $142,723 - $172,723 USD Architect and ship full stack features end to end, own the testing strategy for what you ship, and build internal tooling and testing infrastructure that makes the rest of the team faster. You will work without close supervision and hold the security and compliance bar our customers require. Nice to have: distributed systems and high availability architecture, regulated-environment security, open-source contributions, experience on remote-first teams.

Join our team: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/mattermost/jobs/5379251008

*Staff Full Stack Engineer* $172,724 - $227,135 USD Set technical direction for the platform rather than for a feature area: architecture and roadmap across the stack, the standards for how the org uses coding agents, and the strategy for internal tooling and testing. You will influence direction across teams, partner with security and compliance on it, and mentor senior engineers. Nice to have: staff, principal or tech lead experience elsewhere, open-source maintainership, FedRAMP or ITAR familiarity, defense or critical infrastructure background.

Join our team: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/mattermost/jobs/5405811008

Both roles have Canadian postings: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/mattermost

Zepto | Senior Security Engineer (product security) | REMOTE (AUS) | https://zepto.bamboohr.com/careers/104

As a Senior Security Engineer (Product Security), you will play a significant role in keeping our product safe and secure by building on and maturing Zepto's product security practices. You will work hands-on and shoulder-to-shoulder with Engineering and Product teams, providing guidance and coaching across the software development life cycle while continuing to raise the bar on our security expectations and capability.

This is a security role at its core, but not a gatekeeping one. We are builders – we expect you to read and write production-level code, build tooling and automation, and contribute paved-road solutions that engineers actually want to use. Reporting to the Security Engineering Lead, you will work closely with them to develop and build Zepto's product security strategy and approach. You will apply a consultative and advisory approach when working with the wider Zepto team, empowering them to work confidently and to use the self-service capabilities you help establish.

We have excellent working relationships with our developers and we need to keep it that way. We are not the team of no. We are the team that helps make things better.

Zepto is moving quickly towards an AI-native way of building and operating. You will be someone who is already experimenting with AI and agentic tooling, or is genuinely keen to, and who is open to developing the skills to secure these systems as we adopt them. Within the Security team, you are the go-to person for:

Secure development practices Vulnerability management Security architecture advice

Working in a scale-up, means you get the opportunity to flex your skills in a variety of ways. We are agile and always willing to roll up our sleeves to get things done. You can, however, expect your day to day to be involved in the following:

Coach engineering teams and collaborate to ensure every step of the software development life cycle follows security best practices Design, build and maintain security tooling, automation and paved-road controls as production-quality software Conduct security assessments and architecture reviews of Zepto's applications and services Embed within project teams to ensure they are effectively considering information security risk and prioritising security controls Establish and document security architecture and practices in collaboration with the Security Engineering Lead, Product and Engineering teams Work with the Security Engineering Lead to support Zepto's adoption of AI and agentic systems, and experiment with AI tooling to improve how the Security team works Help manage application security incidents in collaboration with the rest of the Security team

RINSE | REMOTE or San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago, Boston, New York City, New Jersey, Seattle, Austin, Toronto, or Washington DC | Software Engineer | Full-Time | Salary: $80k-$200k USD | https://www.rinse.com

Rinse provides dry cleaning and laundry delivery services to customers in twelve metropolitan areas in the US and Canada. We have sophisticated logistics optimization software, a polished consumer product, and firm business fundamentals. We're now over a decade old - this is a stable, yet consistently growing and innovating, company.

Our engineering team is distributed across the United States and internationally, and has been entirely remote for years now, but a desk can be provided in the above cities if you'd prefer.

We're open to both newly-graduated engineers or more senior engineers, provided they meet our bar. We're particularly interested in true full-stack engineers, with strong React / Typescript / CSS skills to complement comfort in a Python / Django environment. We're also seeking engineers with experience leveraging AI to automate complex operational processes.

This season, we're particularly interested in new grads or junior engineers, to round out the team.

You will join a high-caliber team where collaboration, honesty, and open communication are at the core of everything we do.

Search term bingo: Logistics, Django, Python, Optimization, React, React Native, Postgres, Mobile Engineer, Automation, Delivery, OR-tools, Forecasting

Noricum | Senior Backend Engineer, Payments, Ledger & Provable Fairness | REMOTE (2h overlap with US Pacific) | Contract to permanent | $120-160/hr | Start by 14 Sep

I'm the founder of Noricum where we build platforms – currently the money infrastructure, ledger, engine and payment rails behind a pre-launch wagering platform with a Steam skins economy. The games, a cashier and a bet ledger are built and live as a front end, with written specs for the server contract: ledger schema, refusal table, round lifecycle, every game's arithmetic. Processing and licensing are secured. The server does not exist. That is the job. You would own:

- A server-authoritative game engine - seeds, nonces, outcome computation - A double-entry ledger where balance is derived and no client write can change it - Server-side enforcement of every limit and refusal - Payment rails idempotent under duplicated webhooks - Seed custody and the provably-fair lifecycle - An affiliate system with referral attribution and commission payouts

Must have shipped: a double-entry ledger or equivalent money system in production, a payment integration including webhook idempotency, auth and sessions you built and operated, and infrastructure you owned end to end. Provably-fair systems, settlement-side gaming or trading infra, or Steam trade automation all stand out.

Email michael@noricum.io with your start date and a few lines on the last money system you shipped - what it guaranteed, and how you knew it held.

Biobase | Senior Technical Product Engineer, Technical Product Engineer (Early Career) | REMOTE (US, Canada) | Full-time | $150–230k / $90–170k + equity

Biobase has grand ambitions. We broker biospecimens, whole slide images, and the clinical metadata attached to them, on a supply-chain backbone that we're steadily automating. We’re building healthcare-data-focused agents on top of the datasets that we’re assembling, too.

We'd rather build the thing that removes the work than throw people at it. Two roles, one team, both reporting to the CPO:

Senior Technical Product Engineer ($150–230k + meaningful equity). The product team's technical interface. Architecture decisions and code review on the platform (Python/FastAPI, TypeScript/React, Postgres, Azure); the data pipeline and informatics that take specimen, slide, and clinical data in from suppliers and labs; and product ownership of the internal platform that builds our agents (permissions, evals, cost control, guardrails for sensitive data). You've been the reviewer of record somewhere, you've operated what you shipped, and you think in business problems before tickets.

Technical Product Engineer, early career ($90–170k + equity). Same territory at an earlier stage: the platform, the data pipeline and informatics, and the agents we run against our own operations — with a senior product engineer and our lead engineer reviewing your work and pairing when it helps. Open on background – self-taught, bootcamp, degree, research lab, a career you're leaving – selective on the bar. You've built something and someone else used it.

We build with Claude Code every day and expect you to become both fluent with it and skeptical of it. No ticket queue, no spec handed to you. Comp is salary + equity combos you choose between.

Full postings: https://biobase.ai/careers

To apply: email jobs@biobase.ai with something you built that eliminated manual work and what happened after it shipped. Links over resumes, no cover letter.

Balerion AI | Software + FDE + AI Engineers | San Francisco, CA | ONSITE | Full-time | $250k+ base + seed equity | Visa sponsorship available | https://balerion.ai

We're building agentic AI for mortgage lending — automating document processing and income qualification for loan originators.

Underwriting a loan means pulling numbers out of a few hundred pages of paystubs, W-2s, bank statements, and tax returns, then applying underwriting guidelines that run to thousands of pages of edge cases. Most of it is still done by hand.

Problems we actually work on: routing scanned pages to OCR vs. text extraction when the text layer is unreliable; extraction pipelines where a wrong number is much worse than a missing one; running long agent workflows durably so a failure three steps in doesn't restart the whole loan; and evaluating multi-step output against guidelines that are themselves ambiguous. We put real effort into eval infrastructure, because "the demo looked good" does not survive contact with a lender's compliance team.

Stack: Python, PydanticAI, Restate for durable execution, Postgres, AWS. Frontier models from OpenAI and Anthropic plus open-source models where they win on cost or latency.

We raised an $8M seed led by Kleiner Perkins and have paying customers in production. Team previously at Snowflake, PayPal, Twitter, Atlassian, and Microsoft.

Comp: $250k+ base, meaningful seed-stage equity, 5% 401(k) match, full health coverage, commuter stipend, gym membership, daily office breakfast & lunch. Full relocation to SF covered.

Onsite in SF. Visa sponsorship: yes.

Email hiring@balerion.ai with "HN" in the subject, plus a resume or GitHub.
